description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Solipsys Corporation, an RTX subsidiary, is hiring a Software Engineer to develop Java features for real-time situational awareness Command & Control systems. The role involves designing, architecting, and coding software capabilities in an Agile team environment.
Software Engineer I designing and coding Java features for real-time situational-awareness Command & Control systems

Responsibilities:
• You will develop innovative new features for a new real-time situational awareness Command & Control Systems (C2) using Java
• You will design, architect and code critical capabilities in an active Agile environment
• You will work in a highly collaborate team environment to design, architect and innovate software solutions

Requirements:
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required.​  U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
• Active and existing security clearance required after day 1
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) major obtained by start date
• Experience and/or knowledge in programming multithreaded systems
• Experience in software development using Java or C++.

Preferred:
• Ability to engage & build positive relationships with both customers as well as internal & external employees
• Strong computer science fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms and information retrieval
• Relevant work experience using SW Development tools (e.g. Maven, Apache Ant, Jenkins, etc)
• Relevant work experience with full life cycle development including exposure to software requirements, design, development, debug and test
